name: agent-step-toolkit
description: Build agent-step LangGraph projects and tools — bootstrap a new project (runner library + streaming CLI + scaffold + the required local sandbox service), define graph state once as a Zod schema (single source of truth for reducers + invoke-boundary validation, channel-completeness enforced at construction; agent-step 2.0.0), localize/override every runner-emitted summary via templated system messages, add domain tools (actions / executors / verifiers / controller hooks + invalidatesOnChange; executors request library-state transitions via typed effects) with sandbox extensions per backend, offer engine-owned one-shot bounded choices with turn-provenance locks, add channel-handoff actions with orchestrator/specialized agent roles, completed/abandon/off_topic handbacks, and library-coordinated off-topic delegation (agent-step 2.0.0; the bootstrap scaffold ships the channel middleware wire/streaming contract), end a task cleanly on a handback — task-scoped library slots and the host's declared domain slots are cleared when completed/abandon resolves, so the next task on a middleware-reused thread does not inherit the finished one (agent-step 2.2.0), keep host logic out of the frozen handoff envelope — the handback signal and metadata resolved from state inside the handoff node, a state-derived forced handoff needing no host slot write, a turn-scoped latch so a host model-input guard fires once per caller turn, and a runner-rendered confirmation read-back the model speaks verbatim (agent-step 2.3.0), damp trigger-happy off-topic handoffs — an engine-owned free in-place deflection of an out-of-scope aside per task (pending gates untouched, the model declines and re-asks in the same turn), then a deterministic off_topic escalation on repeat carrying the aside as routing context, opt-in per HandoffSpec with host-overridable wording (agent-step 2.4.0), harden the confirmation gate and move payloads out of prompt prose — stored-byte recap repetition for "pardon?" turns (repeatReadBack + the repeat_pending_confirmation control), propose-time state-aware refusal (refuseProposal), an engine-enforced abort policy, typed model-facing handoff routes (modelRequestSchema), engine-rendered bounded-choice offers/resumes, and transcript-visible choice consumption (agent-step 2.5.0), follow the agent-design-principles reference — twelve measured host-architecture principles plus the five-question port audit, port an existing project onto agent-step, offer Kafka run-tracing observability at bootstrap/port time via the companion kafka-observability plugin (/add-kafka-observability; /pull-library reports when a project's vendored observability library is behind), author params that carry caller-dictated digits with the library's capture primitives (shape rules as refinements so no `pattern` reaches the model-facing schema, spoken-group transcription fields, ambiguous-reading candidate arrays; field wording stays host-owned — agent-step 2.1.0), apply the three-layer test methodology (runner unit / sandbox / prompt-input), and audit a channel middleware implementation against the wire/streaming/handoff contract.
